  • Method Details

    • setAll

      public void setAll(SimulationType simType, String[] types, int[] genJobs, String[] algo, String[] arrivalD, double[] lamb, String[] serviceD, double[] R, double[] X, double[] N, int[] queueN, int[] nservs, double[] S, double[] Q)
      Save the results of previous simulations in this data structure. If you need to save Routing simulations, than nservs, S, Q should be equal to arrays of size = 0. If you need to save Scheduling simulations, then queueN should be equal to an array of size = 0.
      Parameters:
      simType - the type of the simulation to save
      types - if the result is the one from JSIM or from the Animation
      genJobs - number of jobs used for the simulation
      algo - algorithms used
      arrivalD - inter arrival distributions
      lamb - lambdas
      serviceD - service time distributions
      R - response times
      X - thoughputs
      N - number of customers
      queueN - number of queues (only for Routing)
      nservs - number of servers (only for Scheduling)
      S - service times (only for Scheduling)
      Q - queue times (only for Scheduling)
